description.es: Después del funeral, Damián y Marta discuten por Fina. Jesús le dice a Marta que Jaime intentó envenenarlo, pero que se echó atrás en el último momento porque era un cobarde. Marta dice que ojalá lo hubiera hecho. Marta va a la tienda, donde Carmen, Fina y Claudia le dan el pésame. Marta y Fina se encuentran en la cocina. Fina abraza a Marta y la consuela.
description.en: After the funeral, Damián and Marta argue about Fina. Jesús tells Marta that Jaime tried to poison him but gave up at the last moment because he was a coward. Marta says she wishes he had gone through with it. Marta goes to the store. Carmen, Fina, and Claudia offer Marta their condolences. Marta and Fina run into each other in the kitchen. Fina hugs Marta and comforts her.
